notes.title: Phaser Speedrun and Customization Update
notes.content:
[b]Added Speedrun Mode[/b]
        [list]
[*] Sprint through the game in a single run to show off your skill
[*] 	Unlock new customization options
[*]    Compete in an all new leaderboard
[/list]
[b]Added character customization[/b]
        [list]
[*] Added 12 new skins and 8 accessories
[*]Customization options unlocked through achievements and level exploration
[/list]
[b]Minor level adjustments[/b]
	[list]
[*] Adjusted World 1 Level 10 to be more forgiving
[*] Other small adjustments to make specific levels more accessible 
[/list]
[b]Added UI control display[/b]
